$$

$$"] [:db/add "43505f39-47bc-5bcb-a52a-404c18fa49ce" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=2^{x} + 2$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(2^{x} \ln{\left(2 \right)})\,\mathrm{d}x$.

$$" :question/worked-solution "Notice that the numerator is proportional to the derivative of the denominator. So, we introduce the new variable $u = e^{2x}+1.$ Differentiating gives

$$
